name: Overcooked! 2
preset: Default layout, one player per controller (the PS4 game, played on a PS5)
source: Twinfinite, How to Dash (https://twinfinite.net/guides/overcooked-2-dash-how/) and How to Throw Items (https://twinfinite.net/guides/overcooked-2-throw-items-how/); Gamertweak, How To Chop (https://gamertweak.com/overcooked-2-how-to-chop/); GamerDad PS4 review (http://www.gamerdad.com/blog/2018/09/07/overcooked-2-ps4-switch-xbox-one-pc/). Checked 3 Nov 2026. The sources disagree on dash (Circle vs Cross) and on chop/throw (Square vs Triangle): the majority view is used and the disputed rows say so in `check`.
note: verified: "device" = checked on a real PS5. "web" = from the published sources above. false = not sourced; the LLM must not use it until someone checks it on a PS5 (the in-game tutorial shows the button prompts).
coach_notes: This is a cooking game played together. Most questions are about teamwork, so keep answers short: people are mid-level with a timer running.
The same button chops at a chopping board and throws when you're holding food away from a board. Say which one you mean.
In shared-controller mode (two players on one controller) the buttons are different. Only answer for one player per controller.

modes.solo: One player per controller. This is the mode we're teaching.

to_check_on_ps5: Which button washes plates at the sink? Probably the same as chop.
Which button switches chef when playing alone?

actions.plain: Walk your chef around the kitchen
Pick up food, a plate or a pan (or put it down if you're holding something)
actions.check: Implied by all sources (the bottom button), not named outright

actions.plain: Put down what you're holding on the counter in front of you
Chop food that's on a chopping board
Throw the food you're holding to a teammate or onto a counter
Do a quick burst of speed in the direction you're walking
Hand in a finished plate at the serving hatch (the pass)
actions.check: Serving = putting the plate down on the pass

actions.plain: Wash dirty plates at the sink
actions.check: Not sourced: probably the chop button
